 Adult star Liam Fitzgerald, 29, tragically dies in motorcycle accident
 The popular fitness influencer created adult content on OnlyFans for roughly three to four years.
 Liam Fitzgerald
 Liam Fitzgerald Instagram
 Ricky Cornish 
 Nov 02, 2026
 Ricky Cornish Ricky Cornish is the Entertainment Editor for Equal Pride, where he’s covering the biggest queer stories in pop culture for Out Magazine , Them , The Advocate , Pride.com , Plus Magazine , and Out Traveler .
 Based in Las Vegas, Ricky can be seen interviewing the biggest celebrities at red carpets, press junkets, Pride festivals, and premiere events around the world.
 To follow Ricky and see what's trending, you can follow him on Instagram , TikTok , X , Facebook , and YouTube .

 Follow:
 Ricky Cornish on X This story originally appeared on Out .
Adult entertainer Liam Fitzgerald has died. He was only 29 years old.
 His girlfriend, Jamie Lyn Rinaldi, publicly shared the devastating news of his death Halloween. She wrote on Instagram, "It is with the heaviest heart that I share the devastating news that Liam passed away after a motorcycle accident on October 30th at approximately 2 AM."
 She explained that Fitzgerald died as a result of "severe injuries" in the crash. "Despite the efforts of those around him to save him, they were unable to bring him back," she said. "There are no words to describe the heartbreak of this loss. This is an incredibly difficult and heartbreaking time for those who loved him."
 See on Instagram 
 Boasting over 1 million followers on Instagram, Fitzgerald attracted a very broad following for his fitness content, expensive lifestyle, modeling photos, and adult content. He first built his public platform as a mainstream fitness and lifestyle influencer starting in 2021. Shortly thereafter, he expanded his brand into subscription platforms like OnlyFans and Fansly. He consistently maintained these accounts up until his passing in October 2026.
 Fitzgerald frequently credited OnlyFans with completely transforming his life, noting in interviews that it gave him the financial freedom to transition away from grueling 9-to-5 warehouse labor into becoming his own boss. His page predominently features modeling, fitness-focused content, and material explicitly catered to women.
 While his OnlyFans content and fitness coaching attracted a big fanbase, he spent his personal life building a future with his girlfriend. RIP.
